title: Arduino Uno + Alternate Blink (Digital Pins D7 & D8)
description: Construct and verify a 2-LED alternating blink circuit using Pins D7 & D8 with a single shared current-limiting resistor.

steps.title: Place Shared Current-Limiting Resistor
steps.instruction: Insert the 1k ohm resistor from breadboard ground rail (-rail) to row E5.

hints.missing: Place the 1k ohm resistor connecting the (-) ground rail to row E5.
hints.wrong_position: Ensure the resistor connects the ground rail to row E5.

steps.title: Place Red LED (LED 1)
steps.instruction: Insert the Red LED: Anode (longer leg) in row E10, Cathode (shorter leg) in (-) ground rail.

hints.missing: Place the Red LED with anode in row E10 and cathode in ground rail.
hints.wrong_position: Check Red LED pins: long leg in E10, short leg in (-) ground rail.
hints.reversed: Reverse the Red LED: anode must connect to row E10.

steps.title: Place Green LED (LED 2)
steps.instruction: Insert the Green LED: Anode (longer leg) in row E15, Cathode (shorter leg) in (-) ground rail.

hints.missing: Place the Green LED with anode in row E15 and cathode in ground rail.
hints.wrong_position: Check Green LED pins: long leg in E15, short leg in (-) ground rail.
hints.reversed: Reverse the Green LED: anode must connect to row E15.

steps.title: Connect Arduino D7 to Red LED
steps.instruction: Connect a wire from Arduino digital pin D7 to row E10 (Red LED Anode).

hints.missing: Connect a wire from Arduino pin D7 to row E10.
hints.wrong_position: Ensure the wire connects Arduino D7 to row E10.

steps.title: Connect Arduino D8 to Green LED
steps.instruction: Connect a wire from Arduino digital pin D8 to row E15 (Green LED Anode).

hints.missing: Connect a wire from Arduino pin D8 to row E15.
hints.wrong_position: Ensure the wire connects Arduino D8 to row E15.

steps.title: Connect Arduino Ground
steps.instruction: Connect a black wire from Arduino GND pin to row E5 (completing ground path through resistor).

hints.missing: Connect a black wire from Arduino GND to row E5.
hints.wrong_position: Connect Arduino GND to row E5 where the resistor lead is placed.
